title: Herobrine Mobs
description: Gives every mob (and Steve) Herobrine's eyes!
body:
Behold my wondeful new mod: Herobrine Mobs! This texture pack replaces EVERY mob's eyes with pupiless glowing sockets! Just like our good friend Herobrine! Try on the Player Head, get jumpscared by spiders or pigs, or maybe even see a special secret if you get the Steve default skin...
